sources.games: 612 league games since 7.41 (data/heroes/item_stats, support position: under 2.5 last hits a minute), win 57.8%. No item rules: STRATZ pos4/pos5 (331 and 962 games, win 44% and 43%) have no build rows, the league games are 57.8% won; the only 2x+ candidate (Essence Distiller against evasion) does not match its mechanics. One note: Overgrowth against escape heroes. Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py treant_protector.
sources.items: Valve /datafeed/itemdata, 7.41f: no item named by a rule.

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute: ward_dispenser 100% (1), ring_of_basilius 74% (10), magic_wand 53% (10), arcane_boots 68% (12), pavise 30% (21), great_famango 24% (22), solar_crest 28% (24), aghanims_shard 30% (25), blink 80% (25), force_staff 25% (29), staff_of_wizardry 46% (31). Reviewed: dropped Ring of Basilius, Pavise (30%, 21 min, the Solar Crest part), Great Famango and Staff of Wizardry. Blink Dagger is 80% of the won games (25 min), Solar Crest 28% (24 min); STRATZ has no build rows for this hero.

skills.basis: 612 games since 7.41: maxed treant_living_armor > treant_natures_grasp > treant_leech_seed 453 (win 63.4%), treant_living_armor > treant_natures_grasp 91 (win 34.1%), treant_living_armor > treant_leech_seed > treant_natures_grasp 16 (win 62.5%); talents 10: Living Armor Heal Per Second 495/605 (57.6%), +50 Base Damage 110/605 (61.8%); 15: Nature's Grasp Damage 399/441 (65.9%), Leech Seed Damage to Healing 42/441 (66.7%); 20: Living Armor Damage Block 155/168 (73.5%), Leech Seed Bonus Damage 13/168 (84.6%); 25: AoE Living Armor 38/39 (65.8%), Leech Seed Cooldown 1/39 (0.0%).

notes.basis: Valve 7.41f Overgrowth: 3/4/5 s in an 800 radius, deals damage and prevents moving, blinking, going invisible and attacking; works on Debuff Immune units (they break free only if they gain the immunity afterwards); 90-110 s cooldown. The escape group (draft_analysis.ESCAPES) lives on blinks and quick moves.

reason.en: {enemy} escapes from fights: keep Overgrowth until they are inside it, it stops them from moving, blinking and going invisible
reason.uk: {enemy} тікає з бою: тримайте Overgrowth, доки він не опиниться всередині — вона не дає йому рухатися, блінкатися й ставати невидимим
